items.t: Hybrid (IMA) battery pack failing
items.job: Replace IMA hybrid battery pack (new or reconditioned)
items.note: RepairPal lists about $2,967–$3,498 for 2000–2006 cars. Reconditioned packs and rebalancing cost less.

items.t: CVT judder or slipping (automatic cars)
items.job: Replace CVT with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: A fluid change and start clutch recalibration costs far less if caught early. Used CVTs for this car are scarce.

items.t: Catalytic converter wearing out
items.note: Price depends a lot on whether a Honda or CARB-legal aftermarket converter is needed.

items.t: EGR passages clogging with carbon
items.job: Clean EGR plate and valve, replace gaskets
items.note: Upper end includes a new EGR valve if cleaning doesn't fix it.

items.t: Air-fuel (wideband oxygen) sensor failure
IMA light with no assist and stalling at stops
items.job: Diagnose IMA codes and replace junction board or wiring
items.note: Cost can be higher if the motor control module itself is at fault.

items.t: Won't start in very cold weather or with a weak 12V battery
EVAP leak codes P1456 or P1457
items.job: Smoke test and replace EVAP bypass solenoid or cap

items.t: Heater blower motor stops or blows fuse
Low-beam headlights can suddenly go out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 04V-086.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 02V-196.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace piston rings or short block
items.note: CarComplaints owners report average repair costs of about $2,000–$6,000.

items.t: IMA battery deterioration code P0A7F
items.note: RepairPal lists about $2,593–$2,747 for 2012–2014. A software update alone costs much less.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 16V-061 / 19V-500.

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 16V-346 / 17V-030 / 18V-042 / 18V-661 / 19V-502.

items.t: Replacement passenger airbag may be installed wrong (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 18V-268 / 19V-378.

items.t: Roof molding coming loose
Check engine light for EVAP leak from fuel cap
items.note: A smoke test for a real leak adds about an hour.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 20V-314 / 21V-215 / 23V-858.

items.t: Fuel pump can stop working on some 2022 cars (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 23V-858.

items.t: A/C blows warm (condenser leak)
items.note: Often free under Honda's 10-year condenser warranty extension.

items.t: 12V battery stops charging, car may lose power (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 20V-798.

items.t: Wipers, lights or camera may stop working (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 20V-771.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor can crack and set off the airbag (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 24V-064 / 26V-332.

items.t: Rearview camera image may not appear (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 18V-629.

items.t: Airbags and belt tensioners may not deploy (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 18V-664.

items.t: Front seat belt may not latch (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 23V-158.

items.t: Rear center belt may not hold a child seat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 21V-900.

items.t: Touchscreen freezing or rebooting
items.job: Infotainment software update or unit replacement
items.note: Usually a software update; replacing the unit costs much more.

items.t: Sudden braking with no obstacle ahead
items.note: Recalibration or updates are often done under warranty.
